No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. The reaction count model retains the incoming deuteron (one proton and one neutron), incoming triton (one proton and two neutrons), outgoing alpha (two protons and two neutrons) and one separate outgoing neutron. Each outer circle is one nucleon; the four inner rings identify proton roles and are not extra particles. The source 3:1 outer-to-inner ring radius ratio is retained.
